text:
Alex: quick check — PR #2089 is ready: formatting sweep + a very small rename in the kernel selector. planning to merge EOD if no objections. github: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/2089
Maya: looked through it, mostly fine. ruff flagged an unused import in runtime/optimizer.py so i pushed a tiny fix to drop it. also normalized `choose_kernel` -> `select_kernel` in tests. can you run `pre-commit` locally before merging?
Alex: will do. running `pre-commit run --all-files` and unit tests now. fyi CI flagged one trailing-space in docs/README.md earlier.
Sam: i can give the approval once CI is green. one question — do we want to squash the mechanical rename into the same commit as the formatting sweep? seems cleaner. :+1:
DevBot: CI: formatting check failed at 1745556800 — ruff found issues. Details: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/ci/2089
Jordan: squash sounds fine to me. also a tiny docs wording nit: change "latency SLOs" -> "latency SLO" in that README line. happy to include it in the squash.
Maya: ok i'll rebase, run `pre-commit run --all-files` and squash into one commit, then force-push. snippet i used locally to find rename occurrences:```bash
git grep -n "choose_kernel" || true
# then sed -i 's/choose_kernel/select_kernel/g' $(git grep -l "choose_kernel")
```
Alex: thanks — i'll re-run the quick integration smoke locally after your push. planning to merge at 19:30 PT if green.
Sam: ETA ~20m, i'll watch CI and approve once green.
DevBot: CI: build passed at 1745556935 — all checks green.
Sam: approved. :shipit:
Alex: merging now. thx everyone!
